entities.summary: Dmitry Dmitriyevich Pletnyov was a Russian doctor, medical scientist and publicist. He defended his dissertation on cardiac arrhythmias in 1906. He was a member of the liberal Kadet party. He worked in the Moscow University and since 1929 led the therapeutic clinic of the Moscow oblast clinical institute. 1933–1937 he led the research institute of functional diagnostics and experimental therapy. His patients included Vladimir Lenin and his wife Nadezhda Krupskaya, Ivan Pavlov and other party and state leaders/figures of the USSR.
